also: I hope to see you again soon

terms.grammar: jam with the future: presently, very soon
terms.comment: Latin says “I shall see you” where English says “see you”.

terms.latin: Mox, ut spērō, tē iterum vidēbō.
terms.gloss: I hope to see you again soon
evidence: Traupman 17: I hope to see you again soon, mox, ut spērō, tē iterum vidēbō
terms.comment: Traupman’s sentence; its shape, with ut spērō put in, is Cicero’s (Att. 12.2.2).

phrases.latin: jam tē vidēbō et quidem, ut spērō, dē viā rēctā ad mē
phrases.english: I’ll see you soon, and indeed, I hope, coming straight from the road to my house
